established: Every cooperating POST mutation requires a stable non-empty request_id.
The authenticated /v1/action path routes through ReconciledPortableReceiptRuntimeAdapter instead of calling raw world.process_action from the HTTP handler.
Replaying the same action request_id and identical payload returns the settled logical result without a second raw world entry.
Rebinding one action request_id to a different action fails closed with PortableRequestConflict.
The authenticated /v1/player/name path routes through TypedAuxiliaryMutationAdapter; identical replay is idempotent and conflicting payload fails closed.
The authenticated /v1/save/import path routes through RecoverySafePortableSaveManager.import_bundle_recoverable and exposes request state.
A successful recovery-safe import rebuilds the world-facing action and auxiliary adapters only after the saga settles.
Outcome-undetermined control failures are not automatically reexecuted by the API response path.
Read-only status, verify and export paths remain direct reads and were not falsely classified as mutations.

first_run.finding: Direct script invocation from tools/ did not place repository root on sys.path; no mutation-authority test failed.

remaining_local_mutation_debt: tools/genesis_ai_gateway.py AI-link authoritative registration/turn mutation surface
claim_ceiling: This certificate proves the cooperating authenticated HTTP API's action, display-name and save-import mutation routes use the existing durable, typed and recovery-safe request controls at the exact tested head. It does not make authentication a permission oracle, does not prevent arbitrary Python from constructing the raw world, and does not yet close the separate AI-link or hosted gateway mutation surfaces.
